description: The graph's closed relation vocabulary (graph/build._REL_ALIASES, enforced by graph/schema.sql): the six structural members of engine.laws.models.RelationType plus four edge kinds the law model has no use for. The claim-language lexicon (book/claim-language/claim_verbs.json) carries a different 15-member list that does not contain CONSERVES or IDENTITY. Both are mapped onto the mechanism_schema base, verb by verb, in the crosswalk named below.
